description: Metadata for public NIST AI Risk Management Framework HTML pages on www.nist.gov and airc.nist.gov. Each official URL was confirmed with one bounded GET. Each row stores the title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and us_government_work rights. Full pages are not stored. A page that does not state a publication date keeps date unknown. These HTML pages are separate from the NIST PDF rows in us_federal_ai_publications.json.
